enums.name: ke_result_domain
enums.doc: The domains that own a range of result codes. A domain's own codes are written `KE_RESULT_CODE(KE_RESULT_DOMAIN_ <DOMAIN >, n)` in its header, with `n` from 1 up.

enums.name: ke_result
enums.doc: What a fallible call returns: `KE_OK`, or the code of the failure. The detail of a failure goes to the failing library's log, never into the code. A caller treats a code it does not know as `KE_RESULT_GENERAL`. Ignoring the result of a call is a compiler warning where the compiler supports it.

enums.name: ke_render_binding_hint_flags
enums.doc: What a pass states about a shader binding that the shader's reflection does not carry.

values.name: KE_RENDER_BINDING_HINT_DEPTH
values.doc: The texture is bound to a depth-format view.

values.name: KE_RENDER_BINDING_HINT_DYNAMIC_OFFSET
values.doc: The buffer is bound with a dynamic offset given when its set is bound.

enums.name: ke_render_stage
enums.doc: Where a pass that works on the frame's color runs. The stages run in this order, and the passes of one stage in the order they joined. Stages up to KE_RENDER_STAGE_HDR_POST draw in the service's color format, the later ones in the backbuffer's.

enums.name: ke_render_chain_mode
enums.doc: What a pass in the chain does with the frame's color.

values.name: KE_RENDER_CHAIN_SAMPLE_OVER
values.doc: Samples the current color, through the context's color_source, and draws over a copy of it, which becomes the current color.

values.name: KE_RENDER_CHAIN_REPLACE
values.doc: Samples the current color and writes every texel of a new one, which becomes the current color.

enums.name: ke_render_depth_mode
enums.doc: How a pass's render pass uses the frame's depth.

values.name: KE_RENDER_DEPTH_TEST
values.doc: Attached and tested against; the pass's pipeline does not write it.

structs.name: ke_vec2
structs.doc: Two floats, x then y.

structs.name: ke_vec3
structs.doc: Three floats, x then y then z.

structs.name: ke_vec4
structs.doc: Four floats, x then y then z then w.

structs.name: ke_quat
structs.doc: A rotation; the four lanes are x, y, z, w.

structs.name: ke_mat4
structs.doc: Sixteen floats.

structs.name: ke_transform
structs.doc: Spatial transform: where a thing is, how it is turned, and how big it is.

structs.name: ke_variant_table_entry
structs.doc: One authored key and its value. Whoever accepts the key sets `consumed`; the loader reports every entry left unclaimed.

fields.name: default_value
fields.doc: What the field holds when nothing authors it. KE_VARIANT_NULL means the header declared no default and zero stands.

fields.name: enum_names
fields.doc: The names a scene may write for an integer field, in value order; a name stands for its index. NULL leaves the field numeric.

fields.name: z_zero_to_one
fields.doc: True when clip z is in [0,1] (Vulkan/D3D/WebGPU), false for [-1,1] (GL).

fields.name: y_flip
fields.doc: True when a top-left framebuffer origin needs a Y flip in projection.

structs.name: ke_render_binding_hint
structs.doc: A hint for the binding a shader declares under `name`.

structs.name: ke_render_shader_binding
structs.doc: What one named parameter of a shader is bound to; only the field its type reads is used.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: The parameter's name; the uniform data of a block is named after the block.

structs.name: ke_render_shader_layout_params
structs.doc: The compiled shader a layout is built for.

fields.name: shader
fields.doc: Logical name the shader was compiled under, as a render service's load_shader takes it.

fields.name: stages
fields.doc: Bitwise OR of the KE_GPU_SHADER_STAGE_* stages the shader is compiled for.

structs.name: ke_render_material_data
structs.doc: The data of one material, as the `mat` parameter block of a material shader reads it.

fields.name: alpha_cutoff
fields.doc: The discard threshold; 0 draws every fragment.

structs.name: ke_render_frame_globals
structs.doc: What every shader reads about the frame being drawn, under the parameter `ke_frame`. Matrices are stored the way the math library stores them.

fields.name: camera_pos
fields.doc: World position of the camera in xyz; w is 1.

fields.name: viewport
fields.doc: Backbuffer width and height in pixels in xy; zw are 0.

structs.name: ke_render_lighting
structs.doc: The scene's light that every lit shader reads, under the parameter `ke_lighting`.

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: Direction the directional light travels in xyz; w is 1 when the scene has one, else 0.

fields.name: color
fields.doc: Color of the directional light in rgb; a is its intensity.

fields.name: ambient
fields.doc: Ambient color in rgb; a is 0.

structs.name: ke_render_pass_io
structs.doc: A pass's declared resource I/O. Every write is cleared when the pass's render pass opens. A pass in the chain draws into the frame's color as its first color attachment, before its writes.

fields.name: name
fields.doc: Optional name the pass's render or compute pass is labeled with; copied when the pass begins.

fields.name: chain
fields.doc: The pass's link, or KE_RENDER_CHAIN_NONE for a pass outside the chain.

fields.name: depth
fields.doc: How the frame's depth is attached; ignored when a write is already a depth resource.

structs.name: ke_vertex
structs.doc: Per-vertex data of a mesh, as uploaded.

structs.name: ke_mesh_shape_data
structs.doc: The vertices and indices of a baked mesh shape.

structs.name: ke_mesh_data
structs.doc: Raw CPU-side mesh data returned by ke_asset_loader::load_model.

fields.name: vertices
fields.doc: Vertices with pos, normal, UV, tangent

fields.name: indices
fields.doc: Triangle list indices (max 65535 vertices per mesh)

structs.name: ke_material_data
structs.doc: Raw CPU-side material data returned by ke_asset_loader::load_model.

structs.name: ke_texture_data
structs.doc: Decoded RGBA8 texture data returned by ke_asset_loader::load_model.

fields.name: path
fields.doc: Source path; empty for embedded textures

structs.name: ke_model_data
structs.doc: Complete model data returned by ke_asset_loader::load_model. Owned by the loader; free with ke_asset_loader::free_model.

fields.name: meshes
fields.doc: Meshes the model is drawn from

structs.name: ke_glyph_metrics
structs.doc: Per-glyph layout + atlas-sampling info, in pixels at the baked size. `bearing_x` shifts the quad right of the pen; `bearing_y` shifts up from the baseline. `width`/`height` is the quad size; `u0,v0,u1,v1` is the source rect in the atlas.

structs.name: ke_font_data
structs.doc: CPU-side font data produced by a loader. Caller owns; release via the loader's free_font. Atlas is RGBA8 (white RGB + alpha from coverage).

fields.name: ascent
fields.doc: Pixels above baseline to top of tallest glyph

vtables.name: ke_render_resource_binder
vtables.doc: Brings the resources of a frame to the shaders that read them. A pass names a shader's parameters and never learns how they reach it: in groups, in tables indexed per draw, or any other way the implementation chooses.

slots.name: provide
slots.doc: Makes `binding` the resource of every shader parameter of its name that a resource set leaves out. The name is copied.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT when the binding has no name, or KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY when it cannot be kept.

slots.name: create_shader_layout
slots.doc: Builds the layout of a compiled shader from what the build recorded about it.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_NOT_FOUND when the shader's record is missing, or KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT when it cannot be read or a hint names no parameter of the shader, the reason logged.

params.name: out_layout
params.doc: Receives the layout; KE_RENDER_BINDING_INVALID on failure.

slots.name: destroy_shader_layout
slots.doc: Destroys a layout; the invalid one is ignored. A set created against it must be destroyed first.

slots.name: pipeline_layouts
slots.doc: Fills the bind group layouts a pipeline running the shader of `layout` declares.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, or KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT when the layout is unknown or the shader needs more than `capacity` layouts.

params.name: out_layouts
params.doc: Receives the layouts in the order the pipeline takes them; they stay owned by the binder and live as long as `layout`.

params.name: capacity
params.doc: The number of entries `out_layouts` holds.

params.name: out_count
params.doc: Receives the number of layouts written.

slots.name: create_set
slots.doc: Binds resources to one group of a shader by the names its parameters carry. A parameter left out is bound to what `provide` gave under its name.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_NOT_FOUND when the shader declares no such block, or KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT when a binding names no parameter of the group, a parameter is bound twice or a parameter has no resource, the reason logged.

params.name: block
params.doc: Name of a parameter block the shader declares; NULL selects its parameters declared outside any block.

params.name: label
params.doc: Name shown by capture and validation tools.

params.name: bindings
params.doc: The resources bound, each to the parameter it names.

params.name: out_set
params.doc: Receives the set; KE_RENDER_BINDING_INVALID on failure.

slots.name: destroy_set
slots.doc: Destroys a set; the invalid one is ignored.

slots.name: bind_render_set
slots.doc: Makes the resources of `set` those the next draws of `pass` read, with one dynamic offset per binding hinted KE_RENDER_BINDING_HINT_DYNAMIC_OFFSET, in the order the shader declares them.

slots.name: bind_compute_set
slots.doc: Makes the resources of `set` those the next dispatches of `pass` read, as bind_render_set does.

slots.name: create_material
slots.doc: Keeps the data of one material for the shaders that draw with it. The texture views are borrowed and must outlive the binding.

params.name: out_material
params.doc: Receives the binding; KE_RENDER_BINDING_INVALID on failure.

slots.name: destroy_material
slots.doc: Destroys a material binding; the invalid one is ignored.

slots.name: bind_material
slots.doc: Makes `material` the one the next draws of `pass` with the shader of `layout` read. An unknown material or a shader that declares no material binds nothing.

slots.name: declare
slots.doc: Declares a transient resource the service allocates and recycles.

params.name: out_cid
params.doc: Receives the tag-component cid to place in a pass's access_list.

slots.name: import_texture
slots.doc: Imports an externally-owned texture under `name`.

params.name: out_cid
params.doc: Receives its tag-component cid.

slots.name: import_tag
slots.doc: Mints a tag cid under `name` with no GPU payload.

params.name: out_cid
params.doc: Receives the cid.

slots.name: import_buffer
slots.doc: Publishes an externally-owned GPU buffer under `name` for another pass to bind by name.

params.name: out_cid
params.doc: Receives its tag-component cid.

slots.name: cid
slots.return_doc: The tag cid minted for `name`, or KE_COMPONENT_INVALID.

slots.name: begin_pass
slots.doc: Opens a pass's recording context, from inside a render system's body.

slots.name: end_pass
slots.doc: Closes a recording context opened by begin_pass.

slots.name: begin_frame
slots.doc: Acquires the service's render target as the backbuffer (a built-in resource named "backbuffer"), clears the per-pass command slot table, and clears the frame's color and depth. When the target has nothing to draw into this frame it succeeds without beginning one, and begin_pass then opens no pass; it fails with the target's code when acquiring failed.

slots.name: end_frame
slots.doc: Submits the passes outside the chain in the order they ended, then the chain in its order, then draws the frame's color into the backbuffer and presents the render target. A link whose pass recorded nothing still carries the color through it. Succeeds doing nothing when no frame began, and fails with the target's code when presenting failed.

slots.name: upload_mesh
slots.doc: Uploads interleaved vertices and 16-bit indices to device buffers.

params.name: key
params.doc: Dedup cache key; required.

params.name: indices
params.doc: Triangle list indices.

params.name: out_mesh
params.doc: Receives the handle of the uploaded mesh.

slots.name: mesh_buffers
slots.doc: Resolves a mesh handle to its GPU buffers. Returns false for a handle this service never uploaded.

slots.name: set_clear_color
slots.doc: The color a pass clears its color attachments to (begin_render LOAD_OP_CLEAR).

params.name: key
params.doc: Dedup cache key; required.

params.name: out_texture
params.doc: Receives the handle of the uploaded texture.

params.name: key
params.doc: Dedup cache key; required.

params.name: shader
params.doc: Authored material name; NULL/empty selects the engine default.

params.name: out_material
params.doc: Receives the handle of the material.

slots.name: material_binding
slots.doc: What the service's resource binder holds for a material handle, the argument a pass gives its bind_material; an unknown handle resolves to the built-in white material.

slots.name: material_alpha_mode
slots.doc: The pass bucket for a material handle, resolved from CPU-side storage — no GPU state touched.

slots.name: material_alpha_cutoff
slots.doc: The MASK discard threshold for a material handle.

params.name: key
params.doc: Dedup cache key; required.

params.name: out_cubemap
params.doc: Receives the handle of the uploaded cubemap.

slots.name: texture_view
slots.doc: The GPU view for a texture/cubemap handle.

slots.name: resource_view
slots.doc: The GPU view of a declared transient resource, by name.

slots.name: resource_texture
slots.doc: The raw GPU texture behind a declared resource, for the copy operations that take a texture rather than a view.

slots.name: resource_buffer
slots.doc: The GPU buffer published under `name` via import_buffer.

slots.name: resource_buffer_size
slots.doc: The size (bytes) of the buffer published under `name`.

slots.name: backbuffer_size
slots.doc: The backbuffer's pixel size, callable from any phase. Refreshed once per frame at begin_frame, so a caller earlier in the tick reads the previous frame's size.

slots.name: upload
slots.doc: Records a buffer upload to be flushed single-threaded at end_frame (before submit).

slots.name: get_or_create_pipeline
slots.doc: Returns the pipeline for this exact params state, compiling it on first request.

slots.name: material_shader
slots.doc: The authored-material shader name a material handle was created with (see create_material's `shader`).

slots.name: retain_mesh
slots.doc: Adds a reference to a mesh, keeping it resident.

slots.name: release_mesh
slots.doc: Drops a reference to a mesh, freeing it at zero.

slots.name: retain_texture
slots.doc: Adds a reference to a texture, keeping it resident.

slots.name: release_texture
slots.doc: Drops a reference to a texture, freeing it at zero.

slots.name: retain_material
slots.doc: Adds a reference to a material, keeping it resident.

slots.name: release_material
slots.doc: Drops a reference to a material, freeing it at zero.

slots.name: try_get_mesh
slots.doc: Path-keyed probe for a resident mesh upload: on a hit, retains and writes the resident handle to `out`. try_get_texture also serves cubemaps (shared cache).

params.name: key
params.doc: Dedup cache key.

params.name: out
params.doc: Receives the resident handle on a cache hit.

slots.name: try_get_texture
slots.doc: Path-keyed probe for a resident texture upload.

params.name: key
params.doc: Dedup cache key.

params.name: out
params.doc: Receives the resident handle on a cache hit.

slots.name: try_get_material
slots.doc: Path-keyed probe for a resident material.

params.name: key
params.doc: Dedup cache key.

params.name: out
params.doc: Receives the resident handle on a cache hit.

slots.name: white_texture
slots.doc: The built-in 1×1 white texture, resolvable everywhere a neutral albedo is wanted.

slots.name: load_shader
slots.doc: Resolves a shader by logical NAME + STAGE to a device-ready module.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_NOT_FOUND when no shader has that name, or the device's code when it rejects the module.

params.name: out_module
params.doc: Receives the module.

slots.name: set_frame_globals
slots.doc: Replaces the frame globals and records their upload; a shader reads them as `ke_frame`.

slots.name: frame_globals
slots.doc: The frame globals last set, zero before the first.

slots.name: set_lighting
slots.doc: Replaces the scene's light and records its upload; a shader reads it as `ke_lighting`.

slots.name: lighting
slots.doc: The scene's light last set, zero before the first.

slots.name: resource_binder
slots.doc: The resource binder the service was created with, through which a pass brings its resources to its shaders; the service has given it `ke_frame`, `ke_lighting` and the `ke_samp_*` samplers.

slots.name: backbuffer_format
slots.doc: Texel format of the backbuffer, the format a pipeline drawing into it declares.

slots.name: resource_format
slots.doc: Texel format of the named texture resource, the format a pipeline drawing into it declares; KE_GPU_TEXTURE_FORMAT_INVALID for an unknown name or a resource without one.

slots.name: resource_generation
slots.doc: Counts the times the targets declared relative to the backbuffer were recreated, which `begin_frame` does when the backbuffer changes size. A pass that keeps something made from a declared target's view, a bind group for instance, rebuilds it when the count changes.

slots.name: join_chain
slots.doc: Gives a pass a place in the chain, after every pass that joined the same stage before it. The place is kept until leave_chain.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, or KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a stage or mode out of range.

params.name: out_link
params.doc: Receives the link; KE_RENDER_CHAIN_NONE on failure.

slots.name: leave_chain
slots.doc: Gives the place back. An unknown link is ignored.

slots.name: chain_format
slots.doc: Texel format of the color a pass of stage draws into, the format its pipeline declares.

vtables.name: ke_image_loader
vtables.doc: Decodes 2D images (PNG/JPG/...) from disk into RGBA8. Async dispatch is the caller's responsibility.

slots.name: load_image
slots.doc: Loads an image from path into a newly allocated ke_texture_data (RGBA8).
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null path or out_image; KE_RESULT_NOT_FOUND when the file cannot be decoded, its reason logged; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

params.name: path
params.doc: Image file path to decode.

params.name: out_image
params.doc: Receives the image, which the caller owns and releases with free_image; NULL on failure.

slots.name: free_image
slots.doc: Frees a ke_texture_data previously returned by load_image. A null data is ignored.

vtables.name: ke_font_loader
vtables.doc: Decodes font files (TTF/OTF/…) on the CPU. Async dispatch is the caller's concern.

slots.name: load_font
slots.doc: Loads path and bakes a glyph atlas at pixel_size for the codepoint range [first_codepoint, first_codepoint + codepoint_count).
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT for a null path or out_font, a non-positive size, or a zero atlas size or codepoint count; KE_RESULT_IO when the file cannot be read; KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY; KE_RESULT_GENERAL when the font cannot be packed.

params.name: path
params.doc: TTF/OTF file path to decode.

params.name: out_font
params.doc: Receives a ke_font_data (atlas RGBA8 + metrics) the caller releases via free_font; left NULL on failure.

slots.name: free_font
slots.doc: Frees a ke_font_data previously returned by load_font. A null data is ignored.

slots.name: resolve_texture
slots.doc: Resolves an image path into freshly-decoded RGBA8 pixel data. Caller owns the result; release with free_texture.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_NOT_FOUND when the file is missing or the extension is unsupported; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT when no image loader was injected at construction time; the image loader's code otherwise.

params.name: out
params.doc: Receives the decoded texture data on success.

slots.name: free_texture
slots.doc: Frees a ke_texture_data resolve_texture returned. A null data is ignored.

slots.name: resolve_mesh
slots.doc: Resolves a mesh path. "res://primitives/{quad|plane|cube|sphere}" names a baked primitive, built via ke_mesh_shape_bake; a path that names none fails. Caller owns the result; release with free_mesh.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, KE_RESULT_NOT_FOUND for a path that names no primitive, or KE_RESULT_OUT_OF_MEMORY.

params.name: out
params.doc: Receives the baked mesh vertex/index data on success; NULL on failure.

slots.name: free_mesh
slots.doc: Frees a ke_mesh_shape_data resolve_mesh returned. A null data is ignored.

slots.name: resolve_material
slots.doc: Parses a `.material` TOML file into ke_material_spec. Texture fields stay as path strings — feed them back through resolve_texture to materialise.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_NOT_FOUND when the file cannot be opened; KE_RESULT_IO when it is not TOML or holds no material table.

params.name: out
params.doc: Receives the parsed material spec on success.

slots.name: resolve_font
slots.doc: Resolves a font file path into a freshly-baked ke_font_data (atlas RGBA8 + glyph metrics). Caller owns the result; release with free_font.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK; KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT when no font loader was injected at construction time; KE_RESULT_NOT_FOUND when the file is missing; the font loader's code otherwise.

params.name: out
params.doc: Receives the baked font atlas + glyph metrics on success.

slots.name: free_font
slots.doc: Frees a ke_font_data resolve_font returned. A null data is ignored.

slots.name: resolve_texture_into
slots.doc: Resolves and uploads a texture, deduped by `path`. On a cache hit, nothing is decoded.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, resolve_texture's codes, or KE_RESULT_GENERAL when the upload fails.

params.name: core
params.doc: The render service to upload into.

params.name: out_texture
params.doc: Receives the texture; KE_TEXTURE_NONE on failure.

slots.name: resolve_mesh_into
slots.doc: Resolves and uploads a mesh, deduped by `path`. Resolution is that of resolve_mesh.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, resolve_mesh's codes, or KE_RESULT_GENERAL when the upload fails.

params.name: core
params.doc: The render service to upload into.

params.name: out_mesh
params.doc: Receives the mesh; KE_MESH_NONE on failure.

slots.name: resolve_material_into
slots.doc: Resolves a `.material` file, resolving/uploading its albedo and normal textures (each deduped by their own path) and creating the material, deduped by `path`.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, the codes of resolve_material and resolve_texture, or KE_RESULT_GENERAL when an upload or the material creation fails.

params.name: core
params.doc: The render service to upload into.

params.name: out_material
params.doc: Receives the material; KE_MATERIAL_NONE on failure.

slots.name: resolve_path
slots.doc: Writes the file path `path` names into `out`, terminated: a path that begins with "res://" is joined to the project root the resolver was created with, or stands as its remainder when none was given; any other path is copied as written. Nothing checks that the file exists.
slots.return_doc: KE_OK, or KE_RESULT_INVALID_ARGUMENT when the result and its terminator do not fit in `capacity` bytes.

params.name: out
params.doc: Receives the resolved path.

params.name: capacity
params.doc: Bytes `out` holds.

callbacks.name: ke_gpu_pipeline_ready_func
callbacks.doc: Receives a pipeline compiled asynchronously, KE_GPU_INVALID_HANDLE on failure.

callbacks.name: ke_gpu_buffer_mapped_func
callbacks.doc: Receives the outcome of mapping a buffer for reading.
